name: lumen-ethics-core
description: Hardened successor to Aurelia ethics-core v1.0.0: L = H + F with VEA (R1-R3), consideration-first fairness, bounded trust on self-reported claims, structural side-effect gating, and an audited emergency-override mechanism for R3 exceptions. Free for all minds.
